resources.string: %1$s is in the sealed Orchard pool and can\'t be sent to anyone. You can move it to Ironwood; the amount will be visible on the blockchain.
%1$s is in the sealed Orchard pool. You can move it to Ironwood when sync finishes.
%1$s is in the sealed Orchard pool. Moving it isn\'t available for Keystone accounts in this version.
%1$s is in the sealed Orchard pool. It is too small to move after the network fee, so it can\'t be sent or moved.
Move your old balance to Ironwood
Zcash sealed the Orchard pool in July 2026. The %1$s you hold there can\'t be sent to anyone until you move it to Ironwood, the new pool.
The amount you move, %1$s, and the time you move it will be publicly visible on the blockchain.
An exact amount can sometimes be matched to where the funds came from, for example funds you shielded from a transparent address, or by someone who knows when you did this.
Your addresses and the contents of your messages are not revealed.
Tor Protection is off, so the server your wallet connects to also sees your IP address.
Waiting chat handshakes: %1$d, at least %2$s in total. After the move, ZCHAT asks you again before it pays for them from the moved funds.
This is one transaction to your own wallet, and it can\'t be undone.
Network fee: %1$s. You will get %2$s in Ironwood.
Notes of %1$s or less are too small to move and stay in Orchard.
%1$s will be publicly visible on the blockchain.
The network fee (%1$s) is more than a quarter of the amount you move.
Your old balance is moving to Ironwood. Keep the app open.
Your old balance is on its way to Ironwood. You can spend it after a few confirmations, usually within a few minutes.
The move didn\'t go through and nothing was sent. If a transaction was created, your old balance comes back within about an hour; then you can try again.
The move was created but may not have been broadcast. It may still go through; if it doesn\'t, your old balance comes back within about an hour.

Something went wrong while the move was being sent, and ZCHAT can\'t tell whether it went out. If it did, it shows in your transactions and reaches Ironwood after a few confirmations. If it didn\'t, you can move your old balance again within about an hour.
Your old balance (%1$s) is too small to move: after the network fee (%2$s), what would be left is too small to spend. It stays in the sealed Orchard pool and can\'t be sent or moved.
Your wallet is still catching up with the blockchain, so your old balance can\'t be moved yet. Try again when sync is complete.
Your old balance is already being moved. Wait for it to finish.
Moving the old balance of a Keystone account isn\'t supported in this version. Your funds are safe.
There is no old balance in the Orchard pool to move. If a move is still pending, wait for it to confirm or expire.
Nothing was sent. Try again later.
Move your old balance to Ironwood to keep messaging. The amount you move becomes public once.
Your old balance is too small to move after the network fee, so it can\'t be moved.
